headline: Health-Tech Launch and Customer Operations | EHR Implementation | Physician-Trained
summary: Four years at Greenway Health, a US ambulatory EHR company, getting new workflows and features live in real clinics. I implemented close to 200 client practices, trained 200+ providers, nurses and medical assistants, and fed what I saw in the field back to product teams as feature requests, many of which shipped. I worked with Professional Services, Support and Product on defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release. I also took my own AI product, Roovero, from discovery to launch with paying pilot clients. MBBS-trained physician.
greenway_bullets: Implemented close to 200 client practices: discovery, documenting pain points and workflows, configuring practice-specific workflows and widgets, and supporting setup through go-live.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new workflows and released features.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests with product teams; many of the features I shaped shipped to clients with positive feedback.
Sat on the Patient Safety Committee and Functional Advisory Committee: triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: provider personas, workflow mapping, scoping agentic automation and React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Advised product and design on a platform serving 100+ enrolled practices; presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: release readiness, early adopters, go-live support, training, status reporting
implementation, Professional Services and Support hand-offs, client communication
ambulatory EHR, practice management, clinical workflows, patient safety review
React, GitHub, Claude Code, Codex, n8n, LLM APIs
thesis_html: A launch is done when the clinic is using it on a busy Monday.
